what: Mandatory pre-cutover parity gate compares exit codes only, not reportable duplicate clusters
scenario_or_breakage: The binding goal is findings equivalent to today's R0801, not merely matching pass/fail. Legacy and new runners can both exit 1 while disagreeing on which file pairs/clusters are reportable (especially around close()-equivalent gating and disable attribution), and the merge blocker would still pass
suggested_fix: Extend the parity gate to compare a normalized reportable-cluster signature for both commands (for example sorted file-pair plus line-span tuples, or a pylint close()-derived digest) and require equality in addition to exit-code equality; keep exit-code check as a fast precheck only
